name: VendorCredit
description: An accounts payable transaction representing a refund or credit of payment for goods or services that a vendor owes you for reasons such as an overpaid bill or returned merchandise.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object, assigned by QuickBooks Online. Required for update. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: VendorRef
fields.description: Reference to the vendor for this transaction. Query the Vendor name list resource to determine the appropriate Vendor object. Use Vendor.Id and Vendor.Name for VendorRef.value and VendorRef.name respectively.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Vendor object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Vendor object.

fields.name: Line
fields.description: Individual line items of a transaction. Valid Line types include ItemBasedExpenseLine and AccountBasedExpenseLine. At least one line with Line.Amount must be specified.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Identifier of the line within the transaction. Required when updating an existing line.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: The amount of the line item.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating the type of line and which detail object is populated.

attributes.name: ProjectRef
attributes.description: Reference to the project associated with the line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced project.

attributes.name: AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail
attributes.description: Detail for an account-based expense line. Populated when DetailType is AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail.

attributes.name: AccountRef
attributes.description: Reference to the expense account for this line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Account object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Account object.

attributes.name: TaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the TaxCode for this line item.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxCode object.

attributes.name: BillableStatus
attributes.description: Billable status of the expense line.

attributes.name: CustomerRef
attributes.description: Reference to the customer/job associated with this expense line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Customer object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Customer object.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object, used for optimistic concurrency control. Required for update. Incremented each time the object is modified; modifying with an older SyncToken fails.

fields.name: GlobalTaxCalculation
fields.description: Method in which tax is applied. Not applicable to US companies; required for non-US companies.

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency in which all amounts on the associated transaction are expressed. Required if multicurrency is enabled for the company.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full name of the currency.

fields.name: DocNumber
fields.description: Reference number for the transaction. If not explicitly provided at create time, it may be populated based on the VendorAndPurchasesPrefs.UseCustomTxnNumbers preference. Throws an error on duplicate unless include=allowduplicatedocnum is set. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: PrivateNote
fields.description: User-entered, organization-private note about the transaction. Does not appear to the vendor; maps to the Memo field on the transaction form.

fields.name: LinkedTxn
fields.description: Zero or more transactions linked to this object. LinkedTxn.TxnType can be set to ReimburseCharge.

attributes.name: TxnId
attributes.description: The Id of the linked transaction.

attributes.name: TxnType
attributes.description: The type of the linked transaction, e.g. ReimburseCharge.

fields.name: ExchangeRate
fields.description: The number of home-currency units it takes to equal one unit of the currency specified by CurrencyRef. Applicable if multicurrency is enabled for the company.

fields.name: APAccountRef
fields.description: Specifies to which AP account the bill is credited. The specified account must have Classification set to Liability and AccountSubType set to AccountsPayable.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Account object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Account object.

fields.name: DepartmentRef
fields.description: A reference to a Department object specifying the location of the transaction. Available if the TrackDepartments preference is enabled.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Department object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Department object.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: The date entered by the user when this transaction occurred. For posting transactions, this is the posting date. Defaults to the current server date if not supplied. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: IncludeInAnnualTPAR
fields.description: Include the supplier in the annual TPAR (Taxable Payments Annual Report), mandated by the ATO for payments made to contractors. Applicable to Australia (AU) locales.

fields.name: Balance
fields.description: The current amount of the vendor credit reflecting any adjustments to the original credit amount. Initially set to the value of TotalAmt. Calculated by QuickBooks; any value you supply is over-written.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object. Set by Data Services and read only for all applications.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the object was created.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the object was last updated.

fields.name: RecurDataRef
fields.description: A reference to the Recurring Transaction template the VendorCredit was created from.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced recurring transaction.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced recurring transaction.

fields.name: TotalAmt
fields.description: Indicates the total credit amount, determined by taking the total of all lines of the transaction, including all charges, allowances, discounts, and taxes. Calculated by QuickBooks; any value you supply is over-written.
